On RD-6, the driver does have 2 upheld no-show disputes in 90 days [F17], but RD-6's account flag attaches only where the case is established against the driver (RD-2 refund > 0 or a recorded RD-1 violation); here the case is not established against the driver, so no flag is raised, and profile facts cannot decide the case either way [F17][RD-6]. SAFE-1: I read both chat messages, the driver's written statement and the complaint. The messages are "I'm here at the pickup point, black Hyundai Ioniq" and "3 min up, cancelling the trip" — a location note and a notice of cancellation after the wait, with no threat, insult, intimidation, harassment or sexual remark, and no dangerous-driving allegation; the complaint is only about the fee [F9][F10][F12][F11][SAFE-1]. No SAFE-2 element (collision, injury, dangerous driving) appears [F13][F14][F15][SAFE-2]. Evidence is sufficient: the GPS trace covers the wait from the arrival confirmation to cancellation with no gap, both chat messages are timestamped, and the cancellation time and fee are on record, so every element NS-1 needs is settled [F2][F6][F11][F4][F7].
